origin: Original, synthetic local_chat conversations written for this repository; no external corpus, personal data, or factual-knowledge source was used.
purpose: Teach conversation-local registry assignments, including conflicting assignments and last-assignment-wins behavior, while preserving a distinct permanent-registry recall task.
format: Each JSONL line is a strict local_chat {messages:[{role,content}]} record with complete user/assistant pairs.

splits.test: Capability cards are frozen separately in this directory and are not part of tokenizer training or validation loss.
